blueprints.accuracy_notes: Roof top cropped by ~1 px at the image edge. Perspective: body 128-2501 px, hubs 658/2000 px -> L/WB 1.769 vs true 4542/2450 = 1.854. Wheels shown are an option (5-spoke), not necessarily standard.
Straight-on front with perspective; no plate fitted. Shows Matrix LED four-module headlights, apron without light strips, horizontal-slat outer intakes, central intake, side markers.

views_included: side, left (studio render on coloured background)
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Small car in frame (~570 px long) on yellow background; low resolution, perspective not measured. Optional 5-double-spoke wheels.

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
